# Parlor

> Parlor is a TypeScript framework for apps that agents can operate: every action is a UI hook, an HTTP endpoint and an MCP tool, and one React app ships to web, desktop and mobile.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/getting-started.md): Create an app, run it, let the agent use it, add an action, then add sign-in.
- [Actions](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/guides/actions.md): Business logic written once and served as a React hook, an HTTP endpoint and an MCP tool.
- [The agent sidebar](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/guides/agent-sidebar.md): How the sidebar reaches the coding agents on your computer, and how to change it.
- [Agents](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/guides/agents.md): Let external agents such as Claude Code use the app over MCP.
- [Auth](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/guides/auth.md): Add sign-in with parlor add auth, and what it changes.
- [Data](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/guides/data.md): Drizzle tables, migrations, and the database in development and production.
- [Deploy](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/guides/deploy.md): Build the server and the web app for production.
- [Migrating an existing app](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/guides/migrating.md): Port an app to Parlor step by step, with its data, users, logic, pages, webhooks and jobs, and what Parlor does not support yet.
- [Pages and hooks](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/guides/pages-and-hooks.md): File-based routes, and the hooks that call actions from React.
- [Styling](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/guides/styling.md): Tailwind CSS v4, and other Vite plugins through the vite field.
- [Targets](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/guides/targets.md): Run the same app as a macOS, Windows or Linux window, or on iOS and Android.
- [Parlor](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/index.md): Build an app once for web, desktop and mobile, and let agents do everything its UI can.
- [@parlor/auth](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/auth.md): Better Auth for Parlor, its browser client and its tables.
- [@parlor/capabilities](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/capabilities.md): One interface per platform feature, with a web, a Capacitor and a Tauri adapter.
- [@parlor/chat](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/chat.md): The server half of the agent sidebar.
- [@parlor/cli](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/cli.md): parlor dev, build, deploy, db, add and typegen.
- [@parlor/client](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/client.md): The action client, the action Register, and agent views.
- [@parlor/client/react](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/client-react.md): FrameworkProvider, the action hooks, sessions, capabilities and the chat primitives.
- [@parlor/config](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/config.md): parlor.config.ts, its fields, and @parlor/config/tsconfig.
- [@parlor/core](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/core.md): defineAction, the action registry, ActionError, principals and ids.
- [create-parlor](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/create-parlor.md): Create a new Parlor app.
- [@parlor/data](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/data.md): createDatabase, PGlite in development and PostgreSQL in production.
- [@parlor/server](https://cychien.github.io/parlor/reference/server.md): createServer and the HTTP, MCP and sync surfaces it serves.
